description:
Erection of a single storey rear extension to the side of the existing back addition; removal of existing bay window to the rear elevation at ground floor level and installation of aluminium sliding doors. Replacement of all existing front elevation windows with double glazed timber windows to match existing fenestration; removal of existing front elevation balcony door and replace with timber high
performance door. Replacement of all existing rear windows and doors with double glazed aluminium windows and doors to match existing fenestration.
